articles.title: Before crisis strikes-smartwatch tracks triggers for opioid misuse
articles.description: Opioid overdoses continue to take a devastating toll across the United States. According to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in 2023, the nation recorded roughly 105,000 drug overdose deaths overall, with nearly 80,000 deaths involving opioids. Worldwide, opioids are also responsible for the majority of drug-related deaths. A University of California San Diego study published in Nature Mental Health is working on a potentially life-saving measure that may be as simple as strapping on a smartwatch.
